<?php

const BINARY = [
    '+' => 'ADD',
    '-' => 'SUB',
    '*' => 'MUL',
    '/' => 'DIV',
    '%' => 'MOD',
    '<' => 'LT',
    '<=' => 'LE',
    '>' => 'GT',
    '>=' => 'GE',
    '==' => 'EQ',
    '!=' => 'NE',
];

const JUMPS = ['JUMP', 'JUMPF', 'JUMPT'];

const CONDITIONAL = ['JUMPF', 'JUMPT'];

const TRANSFERS = ['JUMP', 'RET', 'RETV', 'HALT'];

const NEGATED = ['LT' => 'GE', 'LE' => 'GT', 'GT' => 'LE', 'GE' => 'LT', 'EQ' => 'NE', 'NE' => 'EQ'];

const INVERSE = ['JUMPF' => 'JUMPT', 'JUMPT' => 'JUMPF'];

final readonly class Instruction
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $op,
        public array $args,
        public array $position,
    ) {}
}

final class Label
{
    public ?int $position = null;
}

final class Unit
{
    public array $after = [], $blocks = [];
    public int $beforeStart = 0, $afterStart = 0, $depth = 0;
    public bool $recursive = false;

    public function __construct(
        public string $name,
        public ?object $function,
        public array $slots,
        public array $before,
    ) {}
}

final class CodeGenerator
{
    private array $code = [], $loops = [];

    public function emit(string $op, array $p, mixed ...$args): void
    {
        $this->code[] = new Instruction($op, $args, $p);
    }

    private function mark(Label $label): void
    {
        $label->position = count($this->code);
    }

    public function finish(): array
    {
        return array_map(
            fn($i) => new Instruction(
                $i->op,
                in_array($i->op, JUMPS, true) ? [$i->args[0]->position] : $i->args,
                $i->position,
            ),
            $this->code,
        );
    }

    public function expression(object $n): void
    {
        $p = $n->position;
        switch ($n->kind) {
            case 'integer':
            case 'boolean':
                $this->emit('PUSH', $p, (int) $n->value);
                break;
            case 'variable':
                $r = $n->referent;
                $this->emit(
                    $r->kind === 'global' ? 'LOADG' : 'LOADL',
                    $p,
                    $r->kind === 'global' ? $r->address : $r->slot,
                );
                break;
            case 'array':
                $this->expression($n->index);
                $this->emit('LOADA', $p, $n->referent->address, $n->referent->size);
                break;
            case 'read':
                $this->emit('READ', $p);
                break;
            case 'call':
                foreach ($n->arguments as $a)
                    $this->expression($a);
                $this->emit('CALL', $p, $n->referent->name, count($n->arguments));
                break;
            case 'unary':
                $this->expression($n->operand);
                $this->emit($n->operator === '-' ? 'NEG' : 'NOT', $p);
                break;
            case 'binary':
                if ($n->operator === '&&' || $n->operator === '||') {
                    $shortcut = new Label();
                    $end = new Label();
                    $this->expression($n->left);
                    $this->emit($n->operator === '&&' ? 'JUMPF' : 'JUMPT', $p, $shortcut);
                    $this->expression($n->right);
                    $this->emit('JUMP', $p, $end);
                    $this->mark($shortcut);
                    $this->emit('PUSH', $p, (int) ($n->operator === '||'));
                    $this->mark($end);
                } else {
                    $this->expression($n->left);
                    $this->expression($n->right);
                    $this->emit(BINARY[$n->operator], $p);
                }
                break;
        }
    }

    public function statement(object $n): void
    {
        $p = $n->position;
        switch ($n->kind) {
            case 'declaration':
                if ($n->initializer === null)
                    $this->emit('PUSH', $n->namePosition, 0);
                else
                    $this->expression($n->initializer);
                $this->emit('STOREL', $n->namePosition, $n->slot);
                break;
            case 'assignment':
                if ($n->index !== null)
                    $this->expression($n->index);
                $this->expression($n->value);
                $r = $n->referent;
                if ($n->index !== null)
                    $this->emit('STOREA', $p, $r->address, $r->size);
                else
                    $this->emit(
                        $r->kind === 'global' ? 'STOREG' : 'STOREL',
                        $p,
                        $r->kind === 'global' ? $r->address : $r->slot,
                    );
                break;
            case 'call_statement':
                $this->expression($n->expression);
                if ($n->expression->type !== 'void')
                    $this->emit('POP', $p);
                break;
            case 'print':
                foreach ($n->arguments as $a)
                    $this->expression($a);
                $this->emit('PRINT', $p, count($n->arguments));
                break;
            case 'if':
                $alternative = new Label();
                $end = new Label();
                $this->expression($n->condition);
                $this->emit('JUMPF', $p, $alternative);
                $this->statement($n->then);
                if ($n->otherwise === null)
                    $this->mark($alternative);
                else {
                    $this->emit('JUMP', $p, $end);
                    $this->mark($alternative);
                    $this->statement($n->otherwise);
                    $this->mark($end);
                }
                break;
            case 'while':
                $start = new Label();
                $end = new Label();
                $this->mark($start);
                $this->expression($n->condition);
                $this->emit('JUMPF', $p, $end);
                $this->loops[] = [$end, $start];
                $this->statement($n->body);
                array_pop($this->loops);
                $this->emit('JUMP', $p, $start);
                $this->mark($end);
                break;
            case 'for':
                $start = new Label();
                $update = new Label();
                $end = new Label();
                if ($n->initial !== null)
                    $this->statement($n->initial);
                $this->mark($start);
                if ($n->condition !== null) {
                    $this->expression($n->condition);
                    $this->emit('JUMPF', $p, $end);
                }
                $this->loops[] = [$end, $update];
                $this->statement($n->body);
                array_pop($this->loops);
                $this->mark($update);
                if ($n->update !== null)
                    $this->statement($n->update);
                $this->emit('JUMP', $p, $start);
                $this->mark($end);
                break;
            case 'break':
            case 'continue':
                $this->emit(
                    'JUMP',
                    $p,
                    $this->loops[count($this->loops) - 1][$n->kind === 'continue' ? 1 : 0],
                );
                break;
            case 'return':
                if ($n->value === null)
                    $this->emit('RET', $p);
                else {
                    $this->expression($n->value);
                    $this->emit('RETV', $p);
                }
                break;
            case 'block':
                foreach ($n->statements as $s)
                    $this->statement($s);
                break;
        }
    }
}

function assignSlots(object $function): array
{
    $decls = [];
    $pending = [$function->body];
    while ($pending) {
        $n = array_pop($pending);
        if ($n->kind === 'declaration')
            $decls[] = $n;
        array_push($pending, ...statementChildren($n));
    }
    usort($decls, fn($a, $b) => $a->namePosition <=> $b->namePosition);
    $slots = [...$function->parameters, ...$decls];
    foreach ($slots as $i => $d)
        $d->slot = $i;
    return $slots;
}

function generate(array $globals, array $functions, object $main): array
{
    $address = 0;
    foreach ($globals as $v) {
        $v->address = $address;
        $address += $v->size ?? 1;
    }
    $g = new CodeGenerator();
    foreach ($globals as $v)
        if ($v->initializer !== null) {
            $g->expression($v->initializer);
            $g->emit('STOREG', $v->namePosition, $v->address);
        }
    $g->emit('CALL', $main->namePosition, 'main', 0);
    $g->emit('HALT', $main->namePosition);
    $units = [new Unit('<init>', null, [], $g->finish())];
    foreach ($functions as $function) {
        $slots = assignSlots($function);
        $g = new CodeGenerator();
        $g->emit('ENTER', $function->namePosition, count($slots));
        $g->statement($function->body);
        if ($function->type === 'void')
            $g->emit('RET', $function->body->endPosition);
        $units[] = new Unit($function->name, $function, $slots, $g->finish());
    }
    return [$units, $address];
}

<?php

const KEYWORDS = [
    'int',
    'bool',
    'void',
    'true',
    'false',
    'if',
    'else',
    'while',
    'for',
    'break',
    'continue',
    'return',
    'print',
    'read',
];

const PAIRS = ['<=', '>=', '==', '!=', '&&', '||'];

final readonly class Token
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $kind,
        public string $spelling,
        public array $position,
    ) {}
}

final class ToyCompileError extends RuntimeException
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $kind,
        public array $position,
        string $message,
    ) {
        parent::__construct($message);
    }
}

function tokenize(array $lines): array
{
    $source = implode("\n", array_column($lines, 1)) . "\n";
    $line = $lines[0][0];
    $column = 1;
    $i = 0;
    $n = strlen($source);
    $tokens = [];
    while ($i < $n) {
        $ch = $source[$i];
        $start = [$line, $column];
        if ($ch === ' ') {
            ++$i;
            ++$column;
            continue;
        }
        if ($ch === "\n") {
            ++$i;
            ++$line;
            $column = 1;
            continue;
        }
        $pair = substr($source, $i, 2);
        if ($pair === '//') {
            $end = strpos($source, "\n", $i);
            $column += $end - $i;
            $i = $end;
            continue;
        }
        if ($pair === '/*') {
            $end = strpos($source, '*/', $i + 2);
            if ($end === false)
                throw new ToyCompileError('lexical', $start, 'unterminated comment');
            $end += 2;
            $comment = substr($source, $i, $end - $i);
            $newlines = substr_count($comment, "\n");
            if ($newlines) {
                $line += $newlines;
                $column = strlen($comment) - strrpos($comment, "\n");
            } else
                $column += strlen($comment);
            $i = $end;
            continue;
        }
        $end = $i + 1;
        if (ctype_alpha($ch) || $ch === '_') {
            while ($end < $n && (ctype_alnum($source[$end]) || $source[$end] === '_'))
                ++$end;
            $s = substr($source, $i, $end - $i);
            $kind = in_array($s, KEYWORDS, true) ? 'keyword' : 'identifier';
        } elseif (ctype_digit($ch)) {
            while ($end < $n && ctype_digit($source[$end]))
                ++$end;
            $s = substr($source, $i, $end - $i);
            $digits = ltrim($s, '0');
            if (strlen($digits) > 10 || strlen($digits) === 10 && strcmp($digits, '2147483647') > 0)
                throw new ToyCompileError('lexical', $start, 'integer literal too large');
            $kind = 'integer';
        } elseif (in_array($pair, PAIRS, true)) {
            ++$end;
            $s = $pair;
            $kind = 'symbol';
        } elseif (str_contains('+-*/%<>=!(){}[],;', $ch)) {
            $s = $ch;
            $kind = 'symbol';
        } else
            throw new ToyCompileError('lexical', $start, "unexpected character '$ch'");
        $tokens[] = new Token($kind, $s, $start);
        $column += $end - $i;
        $i = $end;
    }
    [$last, $text] = $lines[count($lines) - 1];
    $tokens[] = new Token('end', '', [$last, strlen($text) + 1]);
    return $tokens;
}

<?php

foreach (['lexer', 'parser', 'semantic', 'codegen', 'vm'] as $module)
    require_once __DIR__ . "/$module.php";
const RULES = [
    'const-jump',
    'not-compare',
    'not-jump',
    'invert-branch',
    'thread',
    'jump-next',
    'unreachable',
];

const PUSHING = ['PUSH', 'LOADG', 'LOADL', 'READ'];

const POPPING = [
    'POP',
    'STOREG',
    'STOREL',
    'JUMPF',
    'JUMPT',
    'RETV',
    'ADD',
    'SUB',
    'MUL',
    'DIV',
    'MOD',
    'LT',
    'LE',
    'GT',
    'GE',
    'EQ',
    'NE',
];

function collectWarnings(Analyzer $a): array
{
    $warnings = [];
    foreach ($a->variables as $v)
        if ($v->readAccesses === 0)
            $warnings[] = [
                $v->namePosition,
                'unused ' . ($v->kind === 'parameter' ? 'parameter' : 'variable') . " '{$v->name}'",
            ];
    foreach ($a->functions as $function) {
        $pending = [$function->body];
        while ($pending) {
            $s = array_pop($pending);
            if ($s->kind === 'block')
                for ($i = 0; $i < (count($s->statements) - 1); ++$i)
                    if (!canComplete($s->statements[$i])) {
                        $warnings[] = [$s->statements[$i + 1]->position, 'unreachable statement'];
                        break;
                    }
            array_push($pending, ...statementChildren($s));
        }
    }
    $reachable = [];
    $pending = [$a->globals['main']];
    while ($pending) {
        $f = array_pop($pending);
        if (!isset($reachable[$f->name])) {
            $reachable[$f->name] = true;
            array_push($pending, ...array_values($f->calls));
        }
    }
    foreach ($a->functions as $f)
        if (!isset($reachable[$f->name]))
            $warnings[] = [$f->namePosition, "function '{$f->name}' is never called"];
    usort($warnings, fn($x, $y) => $x[0] <=> $y[0]);
    return [$warnings, $reachable];
}

function isRecursive(object $f): bool
{
    $seen = [];
    $pending = array_values($f->calls);
    while ($pending) {
        $x = array_pop($pending);
        if ($x === $f)
            return true;
        if (!isset($seen[$x->name])) {
            $seen[$x->name] = true;
            array_push($pending, ...array_values($x->calls));
        }
    }
    return false;
}

function literalValue(object $n, string $kind, mixed $v): bool
{
    return $n->kind === $kind && $n->value === $v;
}

final class Folder
{
    public int $count = 0;

    private function literal(object $n, mixed $v): object
    {
        ++$this->count;
        return node($n->type === 'bool' ? 'boolean' : 'integer', $n->position, [
            'value' => $n->type === 'bool' ? (bool) $v : $v,
            'type' => $n->type,
        ]);
    }

    private function identity(object $n): object
    {
        ++$this->count;
        return $n;
    }

    public function expression(object $n): object
    {
        if ($n->kind === 'unary') {
            $n->operand = $this->expression($n->operand);
            if (in_array($n->operand->kind, ['integer', 'boolean'], true)) {
                try {
                    $v = calculate($n->operator === '-' ? 'NEG' : 'NOT', (int) $n->operand->value);
                } catch (RuntimeFault) {
                    return $n;
                }
                return $this->literal($n, $v);
            }
        } elseif ($n->kind === 'binary') {
            $n->left = $this->expression($n->left);
            $n->right = $this->expression($n->right);
            $a = $n->left;
            $b = $n->right;
            $op = $n->operator;
            if (
                in_array($a->kind, ['integer', 'boolean'], true)
                && in_array($b->kind, ['integer', 'boolean'], true)
            ) {
                try {
                    $v = match ($op) {
                        '&&' => (bool) $a->value && (bool) $b->value,
                        '||' => (bool) $a->value || (bool) $b->value,
                        default => calculate(BINARY[$op], (int) $a->value, (int) $b->value),
                    };
                    return $this->literal($n, $v);
                } catch (RuntimeFault) {
                }
            }
            if ($op === '&&' && literalValue($a, 'boolean', false))
                return $this->literal($n, false);
            if ($op === '||' && literalValue($a, 'boolean', true))
                return $this->literal($n, true);
            if (
                $op === '&&' && literalValue($a, 'boolean', true)
                || $op === '||' && literalValue($a, 'boolean', false)
                || $op === '+' && literalValue($a, 'integer', 0)
                || $op === '*' && literalValue($a, 'integer', 1)
            )
                return $this->identity($b);
            if (
                in_array($op, ['+', '-'], true) && literalValue($b, 'integer', 0)
                || in_array($op, ['*', '/'], true) && literalValue($b, 'integer', 1)
                || $op === '&&' && literalValue($b, 'boolean', true)
                || $op === '||' && literalValue($b, 'boolean', false)
            )
                return $this->identity($a);
        } elseif ($n->kind === 'array')
            $n->index = $this->expression($n->index);
        elseif ($n->kind === 'call')
            $n->arguments = array_map($this->expression(...), $n->arguments);
        return $n;
    }

    public function statement(object $n): object
    {
        switch ($n->kind) {
            case 'declaration':
                if ($n->initializer !== null)
                    $n->initializer = $this->expression($n->initializer);
                break;
            case 'assignment':
                if ($n->index !== null)
                    $n->index = $this->expression($n->index);
                $n->value = $this->expression($n->value);
                break;
            case 'call_statement':
                $n->expression = $this->expression($n->expression);
                break;
            case 'print':
                $n->arguments = array_map($this->expression(...), $n->arguments);
                break;
            case 'return':
                if ($n->value !== null)
                    $n->value = $this->expression($n->value);
                break;
            case 'block':
                $n->statements = array_map($this->statement(...), $n->statements);
                break;
            case 'if':
                $n->condition = $this->expression($n->condition);
                if ($n->condition->kind === 'boolean') {
                    $selected = $n->condition->value ? $n->then : $n->otherwise;
                    $replacement = $selected === null
                        ? node('empty', $n->position)
                        : $this->statement($selected);
                    ++$this->count;
                    return $replacement;
                }
                $n->then = $this->statement($n->then);
                if ($n->otherwise !== null)
                    $n->otherwise = $this->statement($n->otherwise);
                break;
            case 'while':
                $n->condition = $this->expression($n->condition);
                if (literalValue($n->condition, 'boolean', false)) {
                    ++$this->count;
                    return node('empty', $n->position);
                }
                $n->body = $this->statement($n->body);
                break;
            case 'for':
                if ($n->initial !== null)
                    $n->initial = $this->statement($n->initial);
                if ($n->condition !== null)
                    $n->condition = $this->expression($n->condition);
                if ($n->update !== null)
                    $n->update = $this->statement($n->update);
                $n->body = $this->statement($n->body);
                break;
        }
        return $n;
    }
}

function jumpsOn(string $op, int $value): bool
{
    return ($value === 0) === ($op === 'JUMPF');
}

function deleteInstruction(array &$code, int $p): void
{
    array_splice($code, $p, 1);
    foreach ($code as $i => $v)
        if (in_array($v->op, JUMPS, true) && $v->args[0] > $p)
            $code[$i] = new Instruction($v->op, [$v->args[0] - 1], $v->position);
}

function rewriteAt(array &$code, int $i, array $targets): int
{
    $a = $code[$i];
    $b = $code[$i + 1] ?? null;
    $free = $b !== null && !isset($targets[$i + 1]);
    if ($free && $a->op === 'PUSH' && in_array($b->op, CONDITIONAL, true)) {
        if (jumpsOn($b->op, $a->args[0])) {
            $code[$i] = new Instruction('JUMP', $b->args, $b->position);
            deleteInstruction($code, $i + 1);
        } else {
            deleteInstruction($code, $i + 1);
            deleteInstruction($code, $i);
        }
        return 1;
    }
    if ($free && isset(NEGATED[$a->op]) && $b->op === 'NOT') {
        $code[$i] = new Instruction(NEGATED[$a->op], $a->args, $a->position);
        deleteInstruction($code, $i + 1);
        return 2;
    }
    if ($free && $a->op === 'NOT' && in_array($b->op, CONDITIONAL, true)) {
        $code[$i] = new Instruction(INVERSE[$b->op], $b->args, $b->position);
        deleteInstruction($code, $i + 1);
        return 3;
    }
    if ($free && in_array($a->op, CONDITIONAL, true) && $a->args[0] === ($i + 2) && $b->op === 'JUMP') {
        $code[$i] = new Instruction(INVERSE[$a->op], $b->args, $a->position);
        deleteInstruction($code, $i + 1);
        return 4;
    }
    if (in_array($a->op, JUMPS, true)) {
        $target = $a->args[0];
        $new = null;
        if ($target < count($code)) {
            $dest = $code[$target];
            if ($dest->op === 'JUMP')
                $new = $dest->args[0];
            elseif (
                $dest->op === 'PUSH'
                && isset($code[$target + 1])
                && in_array($code[$target + 1]->op, CONDITIONAL, true)
            )
                $new = jumpsOn($code[$target + 1]->op, $dest->args[0])
                    ? $code[$target + 1]->args[0]
                    : $target + 2;
        }
        if ($new !== null && $new !== $target) {
            $code[$i] = new Instruction($a->op, [$new], $a->position);
            return 5;
        }
        if ($target === ($i + 1)) {
            if ($a->op === 'JUMP')
                deleteInstruction($code, $i);
            else
                $code[$i] = new Instruction('POP', [], $a->position);
            return 6;
        }
    }
    if ($free && in_array($a->op, TRANSFERS, true)) {
        deleteInstruction($code, $i + 1);
        return 7;
    }
    return 0;
}

function optimize(array $code): array
{
    $counts = array_fill(0, count(RULES), 0);
    while (true) {
        $targets = [];
        foreach ($code as $v)
            if (in_array($v->op, JUMPS, true))
                $targets[$v->args[0]] = true;
        $changed = false;
        for ($i = 0; $i < count($code); ++$i) {
            $rule = rewriteAt($code, $i, $targets);
            if ($rule) {
                ++$counts[$rule - 1];
                $changed = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!$changed)
            return [$code, $counts];
    }
}

function successors(array $code, int $i): array
{
    $v = $code[$i];
    $r = [];
    if (!in_array($v->op, TRANSFERS, true) && isset($code[$i + 1]))
        $r[] = $i + 1;
    if (in_array($v->op, JUMPS, true) && $v->args[0] < count($code) && !in_array($v->args[0], $r, true))
        $r[] = $v->args[0];
    return $r;
}

function stackEffect(Instruction $v, array $functions): int
{
    if (in_array($v->op, PUSHING, true))
        return 1;
    if (in_array($v->op, POPPING, true))
        return -1;
    return match ($v->op) {
        'STOREA' => -2,
        'CALL' => -$v->args[1] + (int) ($functions[$v->args[0]]->type !== 'void'),
        'PRINT' => -$v->args[0],
        default => 0,
    };
}

function analyzeFlow(Unit $unit, array $functions): void
{
    $code = $unit->after;
    $leaders = [0 => true];
    foreach ($code as $i => $v) {
        if (in_array($v->op, JUMPS, true) && $v->args[0] < count($code))
            $leaders[$v->args[0]] = true;
        if ((in_array($v->op, JUMPS, true) || in_array($v->op, TRANSFERS, true)) && isset($code[$i + 1]))
            $leaders[$i + 1] = true;
    }
    $starts = array_keys($leaders);
    sort($starts, SORT_NUMERIC);
    $numbers = array_flip($starts);
    foreach ($starts as $i => $start) {
        $end = ($starts[$i + 1] ?? count($code)) - 1;
        $unit->blocks[] = [$start, $end, array_map(fn($t) => $numbers[$t], successors($code, $end))];
    }
    $depths = [0 => 0];
    $pending = [0];
    $maximum = 0;
    while ($pending) {
        $i = array_pop($pending);
        $after = $depths[$i] + stackEffect($code[$i], $functions);
        $maximum = max($maximum, $after);
        foreach (successors($code, $i) as $target)
            if (!isset($depths[$target])) {
                $depths[$target] = $after;
                $pending[] = $target;
            }
    }
    $unit->depth = $maximum;
}

function linkUnits(array $units, string $version): array
{
    $addresses = [];
    $offset = 0;
    $startProperty = $version . 'Start';
    foreach ($units as $u) {
        $addresses[$u->name] = $offset;
        $u->{$startProperty} = $offset;
        $offset += count($u->{$version});
    }
    $code = $owners = $starts = [];
    foreach ($units as $u) {
        $start = $addresses[$u->name];
        $starts[$start] = $u->name;
        foreach ($u->{$version} as $v) {
            $args = $v->args;
            if (in_array($v->op, JUMPS, true))
                $args = [$start + $args[0]];
            elseif ($v->op === 'CALL')
                $args = [$addresses[$args[0]], $args[1]];
            $code[] = new Instruction($v->op, $args, $v->position);
            $owners[] = $u->name;
        }
    }
    return [$code, $owners, $starts];
}

function compileProgram(object $p): void
{
    $p->sourceText = [];
    foreach ($p->lines as [$line, $text])
        $p->sourceText[$line] = $text;
    try {
        $tokens = tokenize($p->lines);
        $declarations = new ToyParser($tokens)->parse();
        $p->analysis = new Analyzer($declarations, $tokens[count($tokens) - 1]->position)->analyze();
    } catch (ToyCompileError $e) {
        $p->error = $e;
        return;
    }
    [$p->warnings, $reachable] = collectWarnings($p->analysis);
    $p->globals = array_values(array_filter($declarations, fn($d) => $d->kind === 'global'));
    $functions = array_values(array_filter($p->analysis->functions, fn($f) => isset($reachable[$f->name])));
    $folder = new Folder();
    foreach ($p->globals as $v)
        if ($v->initializer !== null)
            $v->initializer = $folder->expression($v->initializer);
    foreach ($functions as $f)
        $f->body = $folder->statement($f->body);
    $p->folds = $folder->count;
    [$p->units, $p->globalSize] = generate($p->globals, $functions, $p->analysis->globals['main']);
    $table = [];
    foreach ($functions as $f)
        $table[$f->name] = $f;
    foreach ($p->units as $unit) {
        [$unit->after, $counts] = optimize($unit->before);
        foreach ($counts as $i => $count)
            $p->peephole[$i] += $count;
        analyzeFlow($unit, $table);
        $unit->recursive = $unit->function !== null && isRecursive($unit->function);
    }
    [$p->before, $beforeOwners, $beforeStarts] = linkUnits($p->units, 'before');
    [$p->after, $p->owners, $afterStarts] = linkUnits($p->units, 'after');
    $p->execution = new Execution($p->after, $p->owners, $afterStarts, $p->globalSize, $p->inputs)->run();
    $p->comparison = new Execution(
        $p->before,
        $beforeOwners,
        $beforeStarts,
        $p->globalSize,
        $p->inputs,
    )->run();
}

function spelling(Instruction $v): string
{
    return implode(' ', [$v->op, ...array_map(strval(...), $v->args)]);
}

function formatPosition(array $p): string
{
    return implode(':', $p);
}

function positionDisplay(object $p, array $position): array
{
    return ['  ' . $p->sourceText[$position[0]], str_repeat(' ', $position[1] + 1) . '^'];
}

function listing(object $p): array
{
    $out = [$p->globals ? 'globals:' : 'globals: none'];
    foreach ($p->globals as $v)
        $out[] = "  {$v->address} {$v->name} " . ($v->size === null ? $v->type : 'int[' . $v->size . ']');
    $out[] = 'functions:';
    foreach ($p->units as $u) {
        $signature = '';
        $callees = 'main';
        if ($u->function !== null) {
            $f = $u->function;
            $signature = ' ' . $f->type . '(' . implode(',', array_column($f->parameters, 'type')) . ')';
            $names = array_keys($f->calls);
            sort($names, SORT_STRING);
            $callees = $names ? implode(',', $names) : '-';
        }
        $out[] =
            "  {$u->name}$signature address={$u->beforeStart}->{$u->afterStart} size="
            . count($u->before)
            . '->'
            . count($u->after)
            . ' slots='
            . count($u->slots)
            . " stack={$u->depth} blocks="
            . count($u->blocks)
            . " calls=$callees"
            . ($u->recursive ? ' recursive' : '');
        foreach ($u->slots as $i => $slot)
            $out[] = "    slot $i {$slot->name} {$slot->type}";
    }
    $out[] = 'references:';
    foreach ([...$p->globals, ...$p->analysis->functions] as $d) {
        $used = array_values(array_unique(array_column($d->references, 0)));
        sort($used, SORT_NUMERIC);
        $out[] = "  {$d->name} defined {$d->namePosition[0]} used " . ($used ? implode(' ', $used) : '-');
    }
    foreach (['before', 'after'] as $version) {
        $code = $p->{$version};
        $out[] = "$version peephole: " . count($code) . ' instructions';
        foreach ($p->units as $u) {
            $out[] = $u->name . ':';
            $start = $u->{$version . 'Start'};
            for ($a = $start; $a < ($start + count($u->{$version})); ++$a)
                $out[] = str_pad((string) $a, 5, ' ', STR_PAD_LEFT) . '  ' . spelling($code[$a]);
        }
    }
    $out[] = 'control flow:';
    foreach ($p->units as $u) {
        $out[] = '  ' . $u->name;
        foreach ($u->blocks as $i => [$start, $end, $following])
            $out[] =
                "    B$i "
                . ($u->afterStart + $start)
                . '-'
                . ($u->afterStart + $end)
                . ($following ? ' -> ' . implode(' ', array_map(fn($n) => 'B' . $n, $following)) : '');
    }
    return $out;
}

function diagnostics(object $p): array
{
    if ($p->error !== null) {
        $e = $p->error;
        return [
            $e->kind . ' error ' . formatPosition($e->position) . ': ' . $e->getMessage(),
            ...positionDisplay($p, $e->position),
            'status: compile error',
        ];
    }
    $out = [];
    foreach ($p->warnings as [$position, $message])
        $out[] = 'warning ' . formatPosition($position) . ': ' . $message;
    $e = $p->execution;
    if ($e->error === null) {
        $out[] = 'status: ok';
        return $out;
    }
    $instruction = $p->after[$e->errorPc];
    $out[] =
        'runtime error '
        . formatPosition($instruction->position)
        . ': '
        . $e->error
        . ' in '
        . $p->owners[$e->errorPc];
    array_push($out, ...positionDisplay($p, $instruction->position));
    $callers = array_reverse(array_slice($e->frames, 1));
    foreach (array_slice($callers, 0, 5) as $frame) {
        $address = $frame->returnAddress - 1;
        $out[] =
            '  called from ' . $p->owners[$address] . ' at ' . formatPosition($p->after[$address]->position);
    }
    if (count($callers) > 5)
        $out[] = '  ... ' . (count($callers) - 5) . ' more';
    $out[] = 'status: runtime error';
    return $out;
}

function statistics(object $p): array
{
    $e = $p->execution;
    $c = $p->comparison;
    $same = $e->output === $c->output && $e->error === $c->error;
    $out = [
        'code: ' . count($p->before) . ' -> ' . count($p->after),
        'folds: ' . $p->folds,
        'peephole: ' . array_sum($p->peephole),
    ];
    foreach (RULES as $i => $rule)
        $out[] = "  $rule {$p->peephole[$i]}";
    array_push(
        $out,
        'executed: ' . $e->executed,
        'executed before peephole: ' . $c->executed,
        'behaviour: ' . ($same ? 'same' : 'different'),
        'max call depth: ' . $e->maxDepth,
        'max stack: ' . $e->maxStack,
    );
    $opcodes = $functions = $sourceLines = [];
    foreach ($p->after as $address => $v) {
        $count = $e->counts[$address];
        $opcodes[$v->op] = ($opcodes[$v->op] ?? 0) + $count;
        $owner = $p->owners[$address];
        $functions[$owner] = ($functions[$owner] ?? 0) + $count;
        $line = $v->position[0];
        $sourceLines[$line] = ($sourceLines[$line] ?? 0) + $count;
    }
    $out[] = 'opcodes:';
    $ops = array_keys($opcodes);
    usort($ops, fn($a, $b) => $opcodes[$b] <=> $opcodes[$a] ?: strcmp($a, $b));
    foreach ($ops as $op)
        if ($opcodes[$op])
            $out[] = "  $op {$opcodes[$op]}";
    $out[] = 'functions:';
    $names = [];
    foreach ($p->units as $u)
        if ($u->function !== null)
            $names[] = $u->name;
    usort($names, fn($a, $b) => ($functions[$b] ?? 0) <=> ($functions[$a] ?? 0) ?: strcmp($a, $b));
    foreach ($names as $name)
        $out[] = "  $name calls=" . ($e->calls[$name] ?? 0) . ' executed=' . ($functions[$name] ?? 0);
    $out[] = 'calls:';
    $pairs = [];
    foreach ($e->pairs as $caller => $callees)
        foreach ($callees as $callee => $count)
            $pairs[] = [$caller, $callee, $count];
    usort($pairs, fn($a, $b) => $b[2] <=> $a[2] ?: strcmp($a[0], $b[0]) ?: strcmp($a[1], $b[1]));
    foreach ($pairs as [$caller, $callee, $count])
        $out[] = "  $caller -> $callee $count";
    $out[] = 'hot lines:';
    $executedLines = array_keys(array_filter($sourceLines, fn($v) => $v > 0));
    usort($executedLines, fn($a, $b) => $sourceLines[$b] <=> $sourceLines[$a] ?: $a <=> $b);
    foreach (array_slice($executedLines, 0, 5) as $line)
        $out[] = "  line $line: {$sourceLines[$line]}";
    $out[] = 'coverage: ' . count($executedLines) . ' of ' . count($sourceLines) . ' lines';
    $unexecuted = array_keys(array_filter($sourceLines, fn($v) => $v === 0));
    sort($unexecuted, SORT_NUMERIC);
    $out[] = 'not executed: ' . ($unexecuted ? implode(' ', $unexecuted) : 'none');
    $out[] = 'hot spots:';
    $hot = array_keys(array_filter($e->counts, fn($v) => $v > 0));
    usort($hot, fn($a, $b) => $e->counts[$b] <=> $e->counts[$a] ?: $a <=> $b);
    foreach (array_slice($hot, 0, 5) as $a)
        $out[] = "  pc=$a count={$e->counts[$a]} " . spelling($p->after[$a]);
    return $out;
}

function summary(array $programs): array
{
    $compiled = $runtime = $folds = $executed = 0;
    $errors = array_fill_keys(['lexical', 'syntax', 'semantic'], 0);
    $peephole = array_fill(0, count(RULES), 0);
    $rows = [['program', 'status', 'code', 'executed', 'output']];
    foreach ($programs as $p) {
        if ($p->error !== null) {
            ++$errors[$p->error->kind];
            $rows[] = [$p->name, $p->error->kind . ' error', '-', '-', '-'];
        } else {
            ++$compiled;
            $e = $p->execution;
            if ($e->error !== null)
                ++$runtime;
            $folds += $p->folds;
            $executed += $e->executed;
            foreach ($p->peephole as $i => $count)
                $peephole[$i] += $count;
            $rows[] = [
                $p->name,
                $e->error === null ? 'ok' : 'runtime error',
                (string) count($p->after),
                (string) $e->executed,
                (string) count($e->output),
            ];
        }
    }
    $out = [
        '== summary ==',
        'programs: ' . count($programs),
        "compiled: $compiled",
        "compile errors: lexical {$errors['lexical']} syntax {$errors['syntax']} semantic {$errors['semantic']}",
        "runtime errors: $runtime",
        "folds: $folds",
        'peephole: ' . array_sum($peephole),
    ];
    foreach (RULES as $i => $rule)
        $out[] = "  $rule {$peephole[$i]}";
    $out[] = "executed: $executed";
    $widths = array_fill(0, 5, 0);
    foreach ($rows as $row)
        foreach ($row as $i => $v)
            $widths[$i] = max($widths[$i], strlen($v));
    foreach ($rows as $row) {
        $fields = [];
        foreach ($row as $i => $v)
            $fields[] = str_pad($v, $widths[$i], ' ', $i < 2 ? STR_PAD_RIGHT : STR_PAD_LEFT);
        $out[] = '  ' . implode('  ', $fields);
    }
    return $out;
}

function main(): void
{
    $programs = $byName = [];
    foreach (file('input/program.src', FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES) as $i => $line) {
        if (str_starts_with($line, '#program ')) {
            $p = (object) [
                'name' => substr($line, 9),
                'lines' => [],
                'inputs' => [],
                'error' => null,
                'warnings' => [],
                'folds' => 0,
                'peephole' => array_fill(0, count(RULES), 0),
            ];
            $programs[] = $p;
            $byName[$p->name] = $p;
        } else
            $programs[count($programs) - 1]->lines[] = [$i + 1, $line];
    }
    $current = null;
    foreach (file('input/input.txt', FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES) as $line) {
        if (str_starts_with($line, '#input '))
            $current = $byName[substr($line, 7)];
        else
            array_push($current->inputs, ...array_map(intval(...), explode(' ', $line)));
    }
    $reports = array_fill_keys(['listing.txt', 'output.txt', 'diagnostics.txt', 'stats.txt'], []);
    foreach ($programs as $p) {
        compileProgram($p);
        foreach (array_keys($reports) as $name)
            $reports[$name][] = '== program ' . $p->name . ' ==';
        array_push($reports['diagnostics.txt'], ...diagnostics($p));
        if ($p->error !== null) {
            $reports['listing.txt'][] = $reports['stats.txt'][] = 'not compiled';
        } else {
            array_push($reports['listing.txt'], ...listing($p));
            array_push($reports['output.txt'], ...$p->execution->output);
            array_push($reports['stats.txt'], ...statistics($p));
        }
    }
    array_push($reports['stats.txt'], ...summary($programs));
    if (!is_dir('output'))
        mkdir('output');
    foreach ($reports as $name => $lines)
        file_put_contents('output/' . $name, implode("\n", $lines) . "\n");
}

main();

const TYPES = ['int', 'bool', 'void'];

const OPERATORS = [['||'], ['&&'], ['==', '!='], ['<', '<=', '>', '>='], ['+', '-'], ['*', '/', '%']];

function node(string $kind, array $position, array $fields = []): object
{
    return (object) (['kind' => $kind, 'position' => $position] + $fields);
}

function expressionChildren(object $n): array
{
    return match ($n->kind) {
        'binary' => [$n->left, $n->right],
        'unary' => [$n->operand],
        'array' => [$n->index],
        'call' => $n->arguments,
        default => [],
    };
}

function statementChildren(object $n): array
{
    return match ($n->kind) {
        'block' => $n->statements,
        'if' => $n->otherwise === null ? [$n->then] : [$n->then, $n->otherwise],
        'while' => [$n->body],
        'for' => array_values(array_filter([$n->initial, $n->update, $n->body], fn($v) => $v !== null)),
        default => [],
    };
}

final class ToyParser
{
    private int $index = 0;

    public function __construct(
        private array $tokens,
    ) {}

    private function peek(): Token
    {
        return $this->tokens[$this->index];
    }

    private function fail(): never
    {
        $t = $this->peek();
        throw new ToyCompileError(
            'syntax',
            $t->position,
            $t->kind === 'end' ? 'unexpected end of program' : "unexpected '{$t->spelling}'",
        );
    }

    private function take(): Token
    {
        return $this->tokens[$this->index++];
    }

    private function accept(string $s): ?Token
    {
        return $this->peek()->spelling === $s ? $this->take() : null;
    }

    private function expect(string $s): Token
    {
        if ($this->peek()->spelling !== $s)
            $this->fail();
        return $this->take();
    }

    private function identifier(): Token
    {
        if ($this->peek()->kind !== 'identifier')
            $this->fail();
        return $this->take();
    }

    private function head(): array
    {
        if (!in_array($this->peek()->spelling, TYPES, true))
            $this->fail();
        $type = $this->take();
        $name = $this->identifier();
        return [
            $type->position,
            ['type' => $type->spelling, 'name' => $name->spelling, 'namePosition' => $name->position],
        ];
    }

    public function parse(): array
    {
        $decls = [];
        while ($this->peek()->kind !== 'end') {
            [$position, $fields] = $this->head();
            if ($this->accept('(') !== null) {
                $parameters = [];
                if ($this->peek()->spelling !== ')') {
                    do {
                        [$pp, $pf] = $this->head();
                        $parameters[] = node('parameter', $pp, $pf);
                    } while ($this->accept(',') !== null);
                }
                $this->expect(')');
                $body = $this->block();
                $decls[] = node('function', $position, $fields + compact('parameters', 'body'));
            } else {
                $size = $sizePosition = $initializer = null;
                if ($this->accept('[') !== null) {
                    if ($this->peek()->kind !== 'integer')
                        $this->fail();
                    $t = $this->take();
                    $size = (int) $t->spelling;
                    $sizePosition = $t->position;
                    $this->expect(']');
                } elseif ($this->accept('=') !== null)
                    $initializer = $this->expression();
                $this->expect(';');
                $decls[] = node(
                    'global',
                    $position,
                    $fields + compact('size', 'sizePosition', 'initializer'),
                );
            }
        }
        return $decls;
    }

    private function declaration(bool $initial = false): object
    {
        [$p, $fields] = $this->head();
        $initializer = null;
        if ($initial) {
            $this->expect('=');
            $initializer = $this->expression();
        } else {
            if ($this->accept('=') !== null)
                $initializer = $this->expression();
            $this->expect(';');
        }
        return node('declaration', $p, $fields + compact('initializer'));
    }

    private function block(): object
    {
        $left = $this->expect('{');
        $statements = [];
        while ($this->peek()->spelling !== '}')
            $statements[] = in_array($this->peek()->spelling, TYPES, true)
                ? $this->declaration()
                : $this->statement();
        $right = $this->expect('}');
        return node('block', $left->position, [
            'statements' => $statements,
            'endPosition' => $right->position,
        ]);
    }

    private function statement(): object
    {
        $t = $this->peek();
        $s = $t->spelling;
        if ($s === '{')
            return $this->block();
        if ($s === 'if' || $s === 'while') {
            $this->take();
            $this->expect('(');
            $condition = $this->expression();
            $this->expect(')');
            $body = $this->statement();
            if ($s === 'while')
                return node('while', $t->position, compact('condition', 'body'));
            $otherwise = $this->accept('else') === null ? null : $this->statement();
            return node('if', $t->position, [
                'condition' => $condition,
                'then' => $body,
                'otherwise' => $otherwise,
            ]);
        }
        if ($s === 'for') {
            $this->take();
            $this->expect('(');
            $initial = null;
            if (in_array($this->peek()->spelling, TYPES, true))
                $initial = $this->declaration(true);
            elseif ($this->peek()->spelling !== ';')
                $initial = $this->simple();
            $this->expect(';');
            $condition = $this->peek()->spelling === ';' ? null : $this->expression();
            $this->expect(';');
            $update = $this->peek()->spelling === ')' ? null : $this->simple();
            $this->expect(')');
            $body = $this->statement();
            return node('for', $t->position, compact('initial', 'condition', 'update', 'body'));
        }
        if ($s === 'break' || $s === 'continue') {
            $this->take();
            $this->expect(';');
            return node($s, $t->position);
        }
        if ($s === 'return') {
            $this->take();
            $value = $this->peek()->spelling === ';' ? null : $this->expression();
            $this->expect(';');
            return node('return', $t->position, compact('value'));
        }
        if ($s === 'print') {
            $this->take();
            $this->expect('(');
            $arguments = [$this->expression()];
            while ($this->accept(',') !== null)
                $arguments[] = $this->expression();
            $this->expect(')');
            $this->expect(';');
            return node('print', $t->position, compact('arguments'));
        }
        if ($t->kind === 'identifier' || $s === 'read') {
            $result = $this->simple();
            $this->expect(';');
            return $result;
        }
        $this->fail();
    }

    private function simple(): object
    {
        $t = $this->peek();
        if ($t->kind !== 'identifier' && $t->spelling !== 'read')
            $this->fail();
        $value = $this->primary();
        if ($value->kind === 'call' || $value->kind === 'read')
            return node('call_statement', $value->position, ['expression' => $value]);
        $this->expect('=');
        return node('assignment', $value->position, [
            'name' => $value->name,
            'index' => $value->kind === 'array' ? $value->index : null,
            'value' => $this->expression(),
        ]);
    }

    private function expression(int $level = 0): object
    {
        if ($level === count(OPERATORS)) {
            if (in_array($this->peek()->spelling, ['-', '!'], true)) {
                $op = $this->take();
                return node('unary', $op->position, [
                    'operator' => $op->spelling,
                    'operand' => $this->expression($level),
                ]);
            }
            return $this->primary();
        }
        $r = $this->expression($level + 1);
        while (in_array($this->peek()->spelling, OPERATORS[$level], true)) {
            $op = $this->take();
            $r = node('binary', $op->position, [
                'operator' => $op->spelling,
                'left' => $r,
                'right' => $this->expression($level + 1),
            ]);
        }
        return $r;
    }

    private function primary(): object
    {
        $t = $this->peek();
        if ($t->kind === 'integer') {
            $this->take();
            return node('integer', $t->position, ['value' => (int) $t->spelling]);
        }
        if ($t->spelling === 'true' || $t->spelling === 'false') {
            $this->take();
            return node('boolean', $t->position, ['value' => $t->spelling === 'true']);
        }
        if ($t->spelling === 'read') {
            $this->take();
            $this->expect('(');
            $this->expect(')');
            return node('read', $t->position);
        }
        if ($this->accept('(') !== null) {
            $r = $this->expression();
            $this->expect(')');
            return $r;
        }
        if ($t->kind === 'identifier') {
            $this->take();
            if ($this->accept('(') !== null) {
                $arguments = [];
                if ($this->peek()->spelling !== ')') {
                    $arguments[] = $this->expression();
                    while ($this->accept(',') !== null)
                        $arguments[] = $this->expression();
                }
                $this->expect(')');
                return node('call', $t->position, ['name' => $t->spelling, 'arguments' => $arguments]);
            }
            if ($this->accept('[') !== null) {
                $index = $this->expression();
                $this->expect(']');
                return node('array', $t->position, ['name' => $t->spelling, 'index' => $index]);
            }
            return node('variable', $t->position, ['name' => $t->spelling]);
        }
        $this->fail();
    }
}

function canComplete(object $n): bool
{
    if (isset($n->completes))
        return $n->completes;
    return $n->completes = match ($n->kind) {
        'return', 'break', 'continue' => false,
        'block' => array_all($n->statements, canComplete(...)),
        'if' => $n->otherwise === null || canComplete($n->then) || canComplete($n->otherwise),
        default => true,
    };
}

final class Analyzer
{
    public array $globals = [], $functions = [], $variables = [];
    private array $scopes = [];
    private ?object $function = null;

    public function __construct(
        private array $declarations,
        private array $endPosition,
    ) {}

    private function fail(array $p, string $message): never
    {
        throw new ToyCompileError('semantic', $p, $message);
    }

    private function prepare(object $n): void
    {
        $n->references = [];
        $n->readAccesses = 0;
        if ($n->kind === 'function') {
            $n->calls = [];
            $this->functions[] = $n;
        } else
            $this->variables[] = $n;
    }

    private function lookup(string $name, array $p, bool $read = true): ?object
    {
        $r = null;
        for ($i = count($this->scopes) - 1; $i >= 0; --$i)
            if (isset($this->scopes[$i][$name])) {
                $r = $this->scopes[$i][$name];
                break;
            }
        $r ??= $this->globals[$name] ?? null;
        if ($r !== null) {
            $r->references[] = $p;
            if ($read)
                ++$r->readAccesses;
        }
        return $r;
    }

    private function variable(string $name, array $p, bool $indexed, bool $read = true): object
    {
        $r = $this->lookup($name, $p, $read);
        if ($r === null)
            $this->fail($p, "undeclared identifier '$name'");
        if ($r->kind === 'function')
            $this->fail($p, "'$name' is a function, not a variable");
        $array = $r->kind === 'global' && $r->size !== null;
        if ($indexed && !$array)
            $this->fail($p, "'$name' is not an array");
        if (!$indexed && $array)
            $this->fail($p, "array '$name' used without index");
        return $r;
    }

    private function expression(object $n, bool $callStatement = false): string
    {
        $kind = $n->kind;
        if ($kind === 'integer' || $kind === 'read')
            $r = 'int';
        elseif ($kind === 'boolean')
            $r = 'bool';
        elseif ($kind === 'variable' || $kind === 'array') {
            $n->referent = $this->variable($n->name, $n->position, $kind === 'array');
            if ($kind === 'array' && $this->expression($n->index) !== 'int')
                $this->fail($n->position, "index of '{$n->name}' must be int");
            $r = $n->referent->type;
        } elseif ($kind === 'call') {
            $ref = $this->lookup($n->name, $n->position);
            if ($ref === null)
                $this->fail($n->position, "undeclared function '{$n->name}'");
            if ($ref->kind !== 'function')
                $this->fail($n->position, "'{$n->name}' is not a function");
            $n->referent = $ref;
            $this->function->calls[$ref->name] = $ref;
            $expected = count($ref->parameters);
            $found = count($n->arguments);
            if ($expected !== $found)
                $this->fail(
                    $n->position,
                    "wrong number of arguments to '{$n->name}' (expected $expected, found $found)",
                );
            foreach ($n->arguments as $i => $arg)
                if ($this->expression($arg) !== $ref->parameters[$i]->type)
                    $this->fail(
                        $n->position,
                        'argument ' . ($i + 1) . " of '{$n->name}' must be {$ref->parameters[$i]->type}",
                    );
            if (!$callStatement && $ref->type === 'void')
                $this->fail($n->position, "void function '{$n->name}' used as a value");
            $r = $ref->type;
        } elseif ($kind === 'unary') {
            $r = $this->expression($n->operand);
            $required = $n->operator === '-' ? 'int' : 'bool';
            if ($r !== $required)
                $this->fail($n->position, "operator '{$n->operator}' requires $required operand");
        } else {
            $a = $this->expression($n->left);
            $b = $this->expression($n->right);
            $op = $n->operator;
            if (in_array($op, ['+', '-', '*', '/', '%', '<', '<=', '>', '>='], true)) {
                if ($a !== 'int' || $b !== 'int')
                    $this->fail($n->position, "operator '$op' requires int operands");
                $r = in_array($op, ['+', '-', '*', '/', '%'], true) ? 'int' : 'bool';
            } elseif ($op === '==' || $op === '!=') {
                if ($a !== $b)
                    $this->fail($n->position, "operator '$op' requires operands of the same type");
                $r = 'bool';
            } else {
                if ($a !== 'bool' || $b !== 'bool')
                    $this->fail($n->position, "operator '$op' requires bool operands");
                $r = 'bool';
            }
        }
        $n->type = $r;
        return $r;
    }

    private function constantInitializer(object $n): string
    {
        $positions = [];
        $pending = [$n];
        while ($pending) {
            $x = array_pop($pending);
            if (in_array($x->kind, ['variable', 'array', 'call', 'read'], true))
                $positions[] = $x->position;
            array_push($pending, ...expressionChildren($x));
        }
        if ($positions) {
            usort($positions, fn($a, $b) => $a <=> $b);
            $this->fail($positions[0], 'global initializer must be constant');
        }
        return $this->expression($n);
    }

    private function statement(object $n, int $depth = 0): void
    {
        switch ($n->kind) {
            case 'declaration':
                if ($n->type === 'void')
                    $this->fail($n->namePosition, "variable '{$n->name}' cannot have type void");
                if (isset($this->scopes[count($this->scopes) - 1][$n->name]))
                    $this->fail($n->namePosition, "redeclaration of '{$n->name}'");
                if ($n->initializer !== null && $this->expression($n->initializer) !== $n->type)
                    $this->fail($n->namePosition, "type mismatch in initialization of '{$n->name}'");
                $this->prepare($n);
                $this->scopes[count($this->scopes) - 1][$n->name] = $n;
                break;
            case 'assignment':
                $n->referent = $this->variable($n->name, $n->position, $n->index !== null, false);
                if ($n->index !== null && $this->expression($n->index) !== 'int')
                    $this->fail($n->position, "index of '{$n->name}' must be int");
                if ($this->expression($n->value) !== $n->referent->type)
                    $this->fail($n->position, "type mismatch in assignment to '{$n->name}'");
                break;
            case 'call_statement':
                $this->expression($n->expression, true);
                break;
            case 'if':
            case 'while':
                if ($this->expression($n->condition) !== 'bool')
                    $this->fail($n->position, "condition of '{$n->kind}' must be bool");
                if ($n->kind === 'if') {
                    $this->statement($n->then, $depth);
                    if ($n->otherwise !== null)
                        $this->statement($n->otherwise, $depth);
                } else
                    $this->statement($n->body, $depth + 1);
                break;
            case 'for':
                $this->scopes[] = [];
                if ($n->initial !== null)
                    $this->statement($n->initial, $depth);
                if ($n->condition !== null && $this->expression($n->condition) !== 'bool')
                    $this->fail($n->position, "condition of 'for' must be bool");
                if ($n->update !== null)
                    $this->statement($n->update, $depth);
                $this->statement($n->body, $depth + 1);
                array_pop($this->scopes);
                break;
            case 'break':
            case 'continue':
                if ($depth === 0)
                    $this->fail($n->position, "'{$n->kind}' outside loop");
                break;
            case 'return':
                if ($this->function->type === 'void' && $n->value !== null)
                    $this->fail($n->position, "function '{$this->function->name}' must not return a value");
                if ($this->function->type !== 'void') {
                    if ($n->value === null)
                        $this->fail($n->position, "function '{$this->function->name}' must return a value");
                    if ($this->expression($n->value) !== $this->function->type)
                        $this->fail(
                            $n->position,
                            "return value of '{$this->function->name}' must be {$this->function->type}",
                        );
                }
                break;
            case 'print':
                foreach ($n->arguments as $i => $arg)
                    if ($this->expression($arg) !== 'int')
                        $this->fail($n->position, 'argument ' . ($i + 1) . " of 'print' must be int");
                break;
            case 'block':
                $this->scopes[] = [];
                foreach ($n->statements as $s)
                    $this->statement($s, $depth);
                array_pop($this->scopes);
                break;
        }
    }

    public function analyze(): self
    {
        foreach ($this->declarations as $n) {
            if ($n->kind === 'global') {
                if ($n->size !== null) {
                    if ($n->type !== 'int')
                        $this->fail($n->namePosition, "array '{$n->name}' must have element type int");
                    if ($n->size === 0)
                        $this->fail($n->sizePosition, "array '{$n->name}' must have a positive size");
                } elseif ($n->type === 'void')
                    $this->fail($n->namePosition, "variable '{$n->name}' cannot have type void");
            }
            if (isset($this->globals[$n->name]))
                $this->fail($n->namePosition, "redeclaration of '{$n->name}'");
            if ($n->kind === 'global') {
                if ($n->initializer !== null && $this->constantInitializer($n->initializer) !== $n->type)
                    $this->fail($n->namePosition, "type mismatch in initialization of '{$n->name}'");
            } else {
                $names = [];
                foreach ($n->parameters as $p) {
                    if ($p->type === 'void')
                        $this->fail($p->namePosition, "parameter '{$p->name}' cannot have type void");
                    if (isset($names[$p->name]))
                        $this->fail($p->namePosition, "redeclaration of '{$p->name}'");
                    $names[$p->name] = true;
                    $this->prepare($p);
                }
            }
            $this->prepare($n);
            $this->globals[$n->name] = $n;
        }
        $main = $this->globals['main'] ?? null;
        if ($main === null || $main->kind !== 'function')
            $this->fail($this->endPosition, 'no main function');
        if ($main->type !== 'void' || $main->parameters)
            $this->fail($main->namePosition, "main must be declared as 'void main()'");
        foreach ($this->functions as $function) {
            $this->function = $function;
            $scope = [];
            foreach ($function->parameters as $p)
                $scope[$p->name] = $p;
            $this->scopes = [$scope];
            foreach ($function->body->statements as $s)
                $this->statement($s);
            if ($function->type !== 'void' && canComplete($function->body))
                $this->fail($function->namePosition, "missing return in function '{$function->name}'");
        }
        return $this;
    }
}

const MIN_INT = -2147483648;

const MAX_INT = 2147483647;

const BINARY_OPS = ['ADD', 'SUB', 'MUL', 'DIV', 'MOD', 'LT', 'LE', 'GT', 'GE', 'EQ', 'NE'];

final class RuntimeFault extends RuntimeException {}

function calculate(string $op, int $a, ?int $b = null): int
{
    if (($op === 'DIV' || $op === 'MOD') && $b === 0)
        throw new RuntimeFault('division by zero');
    $r = match ($op) {
        'ADD' => $a + $b,
        'SUB' => $a - $b,
        'MUL' => $a * $b,
        'DIV' => intdiv($a, $b),
        'MOD' => $a % $b,
        'NEG' => -$a,
        'NOT' => (int) ($a === 0),
        'LT' => (int) ($a < $b),
        'LE' => (int) ($a <= $b),
        'GT' => (int) ($a > $b),
        'GE' => (int) ($a >= $b),
        'EQ' => (int) ($a === $b),
        'NE' => (int) ($a !== $b),
    };
    if ($r < MIN_INT || $r > MAX_INT)
        throw new RuntimeFault('integer overflow');
    return $r;
}

final class VmFrame
{
    public function __construct(
        public array $locals,
        public int $returnAddress,
    ) {}
}

final class Execution
{
    public array $globals, $stack = [], $frames = [], $counts, $calls = [], $pairs = [], $output = [];
    public int $readPosition = 0, $pc = 0, $executed = 0, $maxStack = 0, $maxDepth = 0;
    public ?string $error = null;
    public ?int $errorPc = null;

    public function __construct(
        private array $code,
        private array $owners,
        private array $starts,
        int $globalSize,
        private array $inputs,
    ) {
        $this->globals = array_fill(0, $globalSize, 0);
        $this->counts = array_fill(0, count($code), 0);
    }

    private function step(): bool
    {
        $instruction = $this->code[$this->pc];
        $op = $instruction->op;
        $args = $instruction->args;
        $next = $this->pc + 1;
        $frame = count($this->frames) - 1;
        switch ($op) {
            case 'PUSH':
                $this->stack[] = $args[0];
                break;
            case 'POP':
                array_pop($this->stack);
                break;
            case 'LOADG':
                $this->stack[] = $this->globals[$args[0]];
                break;
            case 'STOREG':
                $this->globals[$args[0]] = array_pop($this->stack);
                break;
            case 'LOADL':
                $this->stack[] = $this->frames[$frame]->locals[$args[0]];
                break;
            case 'STOREL':
                $this->frames[$frame]->locals[$args[0]] = array_pop($this->stack);
                break;
            case 'LOADA':
            case 'STOREA':
                if ($op === 'STOREA')
                    $value = array_pop($this->stack);
                $index = array_pop($this->stack);
                [$address, $size] = $args;
                if ($index < 0 || $index >= $size)
                    throw new RuntimeFault("index $index out of bounds for array of size $size");
                if ($op === 'LOADA')
                    $this->stack[] = $this->globals[$address + $index];
                else
                    $this->globals[$address + $index] = $value;
                break;
            case 'ADD':
            case 'SUB':
            case 'MUL':
            case 'DIV':
            case 'MOD':
            case 'LT':
            case 'LE':
            case 'GT':
            case 'GE':
            case 'EQ':
            case 'NE':
                $b = array_pop($this->stack);
                $a = array_pop($this->stack);
                $this->stack[] = calculate($op, $a, $b);
                break;
            case 'NEG':
            case 'NOT':
                $value = array_pop($this->stack);
                $this->stack[] = calculate($op, $value);
                break;
            case 'JUMP':
                $next = $args[0];
                break;
            case 'JUMPF':
            case 'JUMPT':
                $v = array_pop($this->stack);
                if (($v === 0) === ($op === 'JUMPF'))
                    $next = $args[0];
                break;
            case 'CALL':
                if (count($this->frames) === 100)
                    throw new RuntimeFault('call depth limit exceeded');
                [$target, $count] = $args;
                $values = $count === 0 ? [] : array_splice($this->stack, -$count);
                $this->frames[] = new VmFrame($values, $next);
                $callee = $this->starts[$target];
                $this->calls[$callee] = ($this->calls[$callee] ?? 0) + 1;
                $caller = $this->owners[$this->pc];
                $this->pairs[$caller][$callee] = ($this->pairs[$caller][$callee] ?? 0) + 1;
                $next = $target;
                break;
            case 'ENTER':
                $local = $this->frames[$frame]->locals;
                $this->frames[$frame]->locals = [...$local, ...array_fill(0, $args[0] - count($local), 0)];
                break;
            case 'RET':
            case 'RETV':
                $next = array_pop($this->frames)->returnAddress;
                break;
            case 'READ':
                if ($this->readPosition === count($this->inputs))
                    throw new RuntimeFault('read past end of input');
                $this->stack[] = $this->inputs[$this->readPosition++];
                break;
            case 'PRINT':
                $values = array_splice($this->stack, -$args[0]);
                $this->output[] = implode(' ', $values);
                break;
        }
        $this->maxStack = max($this->maxStack, count($this->stack));
        $this->maxDepth = max($this->maxDepth, count($this->frames));
        $this->pc = $next;
        return $op !== 'HALT';
    }

    public function run(): self
    {
        while (true) {
            if ($this->executed === 100000) {
                $this->error = 'instruction limit exceeded';
                $this->errorPc = $this->pc;
                break;
            }
            ++$this->executed;
            ++$this->counts[$this->pc];
            try {
                if (!$this->step())
                    break;
            } catch (RuntimeFault $e) {
                $this->error = $e->getMessage();
                $this->errorPc = $this->pc;
                break;
            }
        }
        return $this;
    }
}
